request.prompt: complete existing reviewed-document envelope, validated server-side

reference_sources.name: display name
reference_sources.text: complete untrusted source, never primary inventory

devices.name: proposed scoped name
devices.quantity: Electronic participants individually named quantity=1; physical/software context quantity1..1000.
source_fact_ids: original fact ids; supplement references never replace these
devices.owner_device_id: optional controller candidate id for local endpoint owner

executor_device_ids: ATOMIC executors; electronic controller/gateway candidates only
realized_by_fact_ids: COMPOSITE references to source FUNCTION facts within same profile

ports.network_scope: candidate network segment identity within source profile

measurements.measurement_id: existing SENSOR_MEASUREMENTS ID; no new registry

communication.producer_fact_id: optional original FUNCTION opaque fact id

unresolved.target_ref: fact/candidate id or full source scope

server_envelope.reference_sources: server-verified manifest; sources remain complete in accepted draft
server_envelope.decision_evidence: server stamps all candidate choices REFERENCE_ASSUMPTION, field path, rationale, source fact ids, source profile context and reference digests; machine cannot claim SOURCE_FACT, USER or APPROVED
server_envelope.coverage: all original components and full REQUIREMENT facts preserved with bindings; incomplete design remains a review finding rather than fake readiness

validation_rules: Validate existing reviewed_document_evidence; do not trust a client replacement fact snapshot.
Exact reference hash, allowed role/field scope, unique reference/candidate ids, no unknown or dangling ids.
Source INSTANCE quantities/roles and previous explicit review decisions remain protected.
All inventory facts covered by electronic devices or explicit PHYSICAL_CONTEXT bindings.
All FUNCTION facts covered; composite graph acyclic, nonempty same-profile links, no executors on composites, no atomic-ref links on atomics.
Host/device/port/consumer profile boundaries preserved; no passive network traffic or false ECU role.
Use TechnologyRegistry and existing signal_integrity checks, physical ranges/raw bit fit/reserved-code separation; do not create parallel registries/calculators.
No position preset for torque/speed semantic commands; physical units/meaning preserved.
Field-scoped references checked per actual field so a communication-only supplement cannot supply device counts.
Primary source and full requirement evidence are copied from validated input, never rewritten from model output.
Persisted accepted candidates retain REFERENCE_ASSUMPTION provenance through normal model review and reload.
root_exports_proposal: validate_reference_design(result, prepared): validated server-stamped detached proposal
reference_design_schema(): schema for local Qwen output
open_adapter_detail: Peer confirms communication field names and whether full communication candidates are in v1 or held as unresolved for existing generator; no silent incomplete simulation readiness.
not_a_model: No candidate here is applied or substituted for NIS inference.
decided_with_peer: ATOMIC/COMPOSITE function realization with acyclic same-profile coverage
Separate original reviewed prompt and role-tagged complete references
Reuse common generation/proposal review/apply, not a second generator
fact_id_protocol: F + sha256(document_fact_identity(fact).encode(UTF8))[:12]; full LegacyIdentity and complete original fact remain server-side in fact_id_map/facts. No full quote JSON repeated as Qwen output IDs.
reference_measurement_registry: Pending existing TS-bridge read export; no duplicate Python ID list.
profile_feedback: Internal shared validator only; whole original request revalidated, exact source profile checked; final project acceptance always checks all facts.

transport_contract.release: Existing native CYCLIC/EVENT/MIXED/ON_REQUEST transmission.profile; no fabricated request/event timestamps.
transport_contract.encoding: Actuator commands bind to selected or inherited encoding; measurement wire unit/type/payload binds to the existing catalog.
transport_contract.ports: Separate stable physical port identities, receive-only without synthetic messages; no-port electronics explicit.
